gated.title: What the gated reconstruction computes at Khufu
gated.note: The stricter reconstruction's own code, unchanged, run on the 2022 pass along 95 lines across the pyramid, 3 m apart. Each voxel is its fit score at that nominal depth below the surface point above it: what the pipeline computes, not a detection and not a validated depth. Beside it, the same calculation on a motionless copy of the image. The satellite drawn above is the 2025 pass.

lab.name: agree_lines
lab.title: Where the east-west and north-south layouts agree, across Khafre, from the 2022 image
lab.note: Across Khafre, the gated reconstruction's lines laid north-south instead of east-west pass 1,158 positions against 1,133; 719 pass both ways, 4.95 times what chance gives, and at 86% of those the best depths agree within half a cycle, against 26% by chance. The 2025 pass passes 650; 110 of its positions pass in 2022 too, 1.33 times chance, their best depths agreeing at 27% against 25%. For scale, the 2022 image and its own motionless copy, which keeps only its smoothed brightness and has nothing under it, share 1.32 times chance and agree in depth at 38%. What passes, and at what depth, does not survive a change of pass beyond chance.

lab.name: agree_sphinx_pass
lab.title: Where the 2022 and 2025 passes agree, across the Sphinx, north-south lines
lab.note: The 2022 volume's largest blob (643 positions, at the statue's south side) does not come back on the 2025 pass: 13% of its positions pass there, where 11% pass elsewhere; carried toward the satellite as rock standing up to 30 m above the lines would be, it reaches at most 19% (at 27.5 m). The second (336 positions, at the statue's west end) stays put: 40% of its positions pass in 2025, against 11% elsewhere, and the motionless copies, with nothing moving, gather there too (28% and 31%, against 9% and 8%). Its depth does not hold: its best scores stand at a median 6.8 m in 2022 and 2.9 m in 2025 (1.10 and 0.77 turns of fits that span 6.18 and 3.81 m a turn), where a void would stand at one depth. Across the square, 496 positions pass in both passes against 362 by chance (1.37 times; shifted maps 358), and the two motionless copies agree 1.70 times chance: the passes agree no more than the images' texture does on its own. Neither blob behaves as a void would.
